export.pixel_rule: Byte-for-byte copy of the user-preserved HeartGold extraction; no redraw, crop, resampling, recoloring, or synthetic pixels.
export.png_encoding: indexed 4bpp palette; exact rendered RGBA pixels preserved; HGSS placeholder remains palette index 8

decomp_verification.behavior: HGSS builds 18 content-sensitive 32x32 box thumbnails and presents six at a time with group navigation.

status: phase 3 complete: authenticated HGSS six-at-a-time box overview owns destination browsing after the full CI verification gate passed
next: Advance to the next Storage UI role audit using authentic HGSS asset -> wire live -> remove legacy equivalent.

live_integration.renderer: six 32x32 HGSS overview cells rebuilt per visible group; GBA 4bpp adaptation uses 32x32 base/wallpaper OBJ cells plus centered 16x16 marker OBJ cells with exact source pixels/colors
live_integration.grouping: six consecutive boxes; group base = floor(candidate_box / 6) * 6; nonexistent trailing expansion box ids are left blank
live_integration.fidelity_guard: No synthetic thumbnail pixels or colors are introduced. Member-70 visible pixels, member-75 wallpaper colors, ov14_021F8080 marker colors, native six-cell positions, and ov14_021F4A64 marker geometry are preserved.

wallpaper_mutation.mapping: wallpaper ids 0-15 use exact member-75 indices 16-31; ids 16-23 fold to 0-7 exactly as ov14_021E7930 does for overview thumbnails

marker_mutation.egg_rule: Manaphy eggs use BLUE; all other eggs use WHITE

live_integration.gba_palette_adaptation: HGSS 8bpp base/wallpaper and 0x20+ marker indices are split into two centered 4bpp OBJ layers. The marker layer stores only the native occupied middle region (base-local x=8..23,y=8..23), reducing OBJ VRAM while leaving every visible BGR555 color and pixel position unchanged.
live_integration.selection_flow: Left/Right changes the authenticated overview candidate without full-box preview scrolling; A confirms and runs the normal Storage transition once if the destination differs; B cancels immediately.
live_integration.verification_gate: Full CI passed before phase-3 legacy removal: Emerald, FireRed, LeafGreen, release, Gen-4 UI, docs validation, and general test.
